name: Conveyor grasping view
summary: The grasping cell in 3D (belt, bin, camera, object, five-fingered hand and the xArm posed by inverse kinematics), the camera's picture with the network's box, the touch sensors, and the test's object
help: Wire the Conveyor grasping block's telemetry into Live and the xArm model's output into Arm model (if the file cannot reach the view, a simple xArm 6 is drawn from its kinematics). Training runs: an episode is replayed every few seconds. Test: choose an object (new to the robot, or seen in training), how it lies, how it is turned and the belt's speed, then Put it on the belt; the trial plays live with what the camera sees and what the fingertips and the palm feel.

inputs.label: Live
inputs.help: The Conveyor grasping block's telemetry (robot and events channels), straight or through a Telemetry block

inputs.label: Arm model
inputs.help: xarm6.robot.json.gz from the xArm model block (or the same file in the project's assets)
